summary: Avis Budget Group filed an 8-K reporting a settlement of a Section 16(b) short-swing profit lawsuit with Pentwater Capital Management for $650 million in cash, subject to court approval. This is a litigation resolution, not a strategic transaction. No acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation is involved. The filing is purely an update on an ongoing legal matter. Therefore, it does not meet the criteria for any special-situations category.
